verdict.rationale: Plaid's docs confirm the product extracts and checks fields like name, date of birth, ID numbers, and address (docs-1, docs-24), and the Dashboard exposes risk factors and status per session (docs-11, docs-20, docs-27), implying underlying structured data exists. However, none of the evidence explicitly documents an API response schema or endpoint returning these extracted document fields as retrievable structured data to developers — it's only inferred from feature descriptions and dashboard UI mentions. Missing for 10: explicit API/webhook payload documentation showing field-level extracted data (name, DOB, document number, address, expiry) returned via API rather than just dashboard visualization or pass/fail status.
